Actor Aamir Khan's third marriage sparks varied reactions and commentary

Actor Aamir Khan's third marriage has drawn commentary from various public figures and groups. Actor Shekhar Suman made a remark comparing Khan's marital status to a "triple engine" government. Separately, Maharashtra minister and BJP leader Nitesh Rane called Khan a "brand ambassador of love jihad" and urged Hindu youth to reconsider their role models. The Bajrang Dal also protested Khan's marriage, burning his effigy.
